correctness.rationale: Choose a Weierstrass point w as base for the theta divisor C−w in the genus-two Jacobian. Its intersections with the 2-torsion are exactly the six classes o_i=[w_i−w], since 2P∼2w precisely at the ramification points. The tropes come from 2-torsion translates of this theta divisor. Label the two classes of vertices by a copy each of J[2]; incidence is translation by the six o_i. Therefore the Levi graph is the Cayley graph on F₂⊕J[2] with generators (1,o_i). There is no dependency of weight 2 or 4: the o_i are distinct, and an equality between sums of disjoint pairs would identify two different effective degree-two divisors, each a pair of distinct Weierstrass points, outside the unique hyperelliptic pencil. Odd-length relations are impossible by the first coordinate. Thus the six generators in dimension five form one circuit and the graph is exactly the folded six-cube, independently of the parameters (this argument works in odd characteristic as well). I built the graph using the five unit vectors and their sum. Its exact Laplacian characteristic polynomial gives the stated spectrum and connectivity, and the cofactor determinant is 3·2^72. Exact Smith form gives 1(12), 2(4), 4, 16(4), 32(9), 96. The 96 incidences give cycle rank 65.
